EXCEL_IMPORT.TITLE: Excel import
EXCEL_IMPORT.SUBTITLE: Criteria and questions organized by dimension
EXCEL_IMPORT.DOWNLOAD_TEMPLATE_READY: The structure is complete. You can download the dynamic template.
EXCEL_IMPORT.DOWNLOAD_TEMPLATE_REQUIREMENTS: Complete dimension weights to 100% and define positions with scenarios weighted to 100% to enable the download.
EXCEL_IMPORT.SUCCESS_TEXT: {{positions}} positions were processed and {{dimensions}} new dimensions, {{criteria}} new criteria, and {{items}} new items were added. {{existingDimensions}} existing dimensions and {{existingCriteria}} existing criteria were reused; {{existingItems}} duplicate items were not added. Each new value was added only to its specified position and scenario. Changes are saved to the database only when the evaluation is saved.
EXCEL_IMPORT.OMITTED_SCENARIOS_WARNING: The following scenarios do not apply to the current employee structure and were not imported. All other data was loaded normally:
EXCEL_IMPORT.WEIGHTS_RECALCULATED: Applicable scenario weights were adjusted proportionally to preserve a total of 100% per position.
EXCEL_IMPORT.ERROR_TITLE: The Excel file could not be loaded
EXCEL_IMPORT.UNEXPECTED_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred while reading the file.
EXCEL_IMPORT.README_SHEET: The workbook contains one sheet for each dimension configured in the model. Do not rename or delete these sheets. Add criteria and questions as new rows in the corresponding dimension.
EXCEL_IMPORT.README_POSITION: The POSITIONS and EVALUATION SCENARIOS columns are prefilled with the valid selections defined under Positions and evaluators. Their cells are merged across every row in the group and apply each criterion and question to all listed combinations.
EXCEL_IMPORT.README_MULTIPLE: Excel does not support a checkbox multi-select list inside a cell without macros. For safety, multiple selections are written with the | character as separator. You may keep them, remove values, or type several values using that separator; every value is validated during import.
EXCEL_IMPORT.README_BLOCKS: Each criterion forms a vertical group. CRITERION, WEIGHT, and REQUIRED RATING cells are merged according to the number of questions, while QUESTION and QUESTION TYPE keep one row per item. Add another criterion as a new group below the previous one.
EXCEL_IMPORT.README_ROWS: To add questions to a criterion, insert the necessary rows and extend the merged criterion, weight, and required rating cells. You may also repeat those values on every row; the importer accepts both forms. Completely empty rows are ignored.
EXCEL_IMPORT.README_CODES: Dimension, criterion, and item codes are generated automatically during import and must not be included in the file.
EXCEL_IMPORT.README_TYPES: Supported types: 5-level Likert and Open question.
EXCEL_IMPORT.README_WEIGHTS: Unique criterion weights must total 100% for each position, scenario, and dimension combination. Required rating must be an integer from 1 to 100. The examples use 50% + 50% and an 80% required rating.
EXCEL_IMPORT.README_AUTOMATIC: The dimension and its weight come from the sheet name; the scenario and its weight come from the position configuration. The Compliance scale is assigned automatically. Descriptions and technical codes are completed inside the system.
EXCEL_IMPORT.README_ATOMIC: The entire file is validated and merged into the draft. Existing values for the same position and scenario are skipped to prevent duplicates; nothing is saved to the database until Save evaluation is pressed.

LIST.OVERVIEW_TEXT: Use this page to review and manage the selected organization's performance evaluation models.
LIST.CREATE_TEXT: Create a model and define its general information, participants, scenarios, dimensions, criteria, and questionss.
LIST.CARDS_TEXT: Each card displays the model status, scale, type, period, progress, and main structure.
LIST.ACTIONS_TEXT: Edit the survey, manage deliveries, review the evaluation diagram, or duplicate the model from this area.
LIST.CARD_IDENTITY_TEXT: The header identifies the evaluation, its organization, and the catalog model used as its configuration base.
LIST.CARD_STATUS_TEXT: These indicators show the current model status, the response scale, and whether the evaluation is 90°, 180°, 360°, self-assessment, or mixed.
LIST.CARD_METRICS_TEXT: Review the number of active participants, configured dimensions, completed evaluations, and overall response progress.
LIST.CARD_DIMENSIONS_TEXT: Each section is a model dimension, such as Objectives, Competencies, or Values. The percentage indicates its weighting in the final result.
LIST.CARD_CRITERIA_TEXT: The chips list the criteria included in the dimension. The number in parentheses indicates how many questionss or questions belong to each criterion.
LIST.EDIT_ACTION_TEXT: Open the complete model configuration to update general information, participants, scenarios, dimensions, criteria, items, and weightings.
LIST.SEND_ACTION_TEXT: Prepare assignments, review evaluators and evaluatees, choose the delivery channel, preview messages, and send evaluations.
LIST.DIAGRAM_ACTION_TEXT: Display the evaluator-to-evaluatee relationships as a diagram to verify that the model scenarios and assignments are correct.
LIST.DUPLICATE_ACTION_TEXT: Create a new model with the same configuration, participants, scenarios, dimensions, criteria, and items, using a different name.

EDITOR.OVERVIEW_TEXT: This dialog contains the complete model configuration. Use the tabs to move through the catalog, participants, scenarios, criteria, and items.
EDITOR.GENERAL_TEXT: Enter the evaluation name, description, type, status, scale, and application period.
EDITOR.EXCEL_TEXT: Download the template or upload a validated workbook to add positions, scenarios, dimensions, criteria, and items without duplicating existing information.
EDITOR.DIMENSIONS_TEXT: Define the model dimensions and make sure their weights total 100% before saving.
EDITOR.SAVE_TEXT: Save the current model progress. You can continue configuring it later from its evaluation card.

SEND.OVERVIEW_TEXT: Use this dialog to prepare, review, and send the evaluations assigned to each evaluator.
SEND.ACTIONS_TEXT: Review evaluator and evaluatee relationships, then create the delivery records before sending communications.
SEND.SUMMARY_TEXT: These indicators show the total evaluators and assignments generated for the model.
SEND.TABLE_TEXT: Review contact details, position, evaluatees, channel, date, and status. The actions let you create, preview, or send each evaluation.
